tests.scope: Full suite includes final M040 factory and hinge geometry. Final focused run independently checks all 24 forms, source reuse, actual openings and twelve hand studies.

findings: Final bucket rim follows the actual bevelled rectangular vessel, correcting the first ellipse mismatch.
Cloth has one continuous fold, thick closed fabric and woven colour bands. It remains a rigid simplified fold rather than soft fabric.
Original closed LIFE106 book has paper-edge steps and rigid covers; kept as a shared legacy master.
Brush white bristles and ink tip, stethoscope tubes and optical head, probe optics and equipment display panels remain distinct physical materials.
Case now has a continuous metal lower and upper surround; original native corner fasteners contact actual surfaces.
Lamp material view visibly reveals a separate physical core through the glazing with no glow; base-colour inspection keeps glazing opaque.
Screens are blank/inactive and labels use abstract lines, with no fabricated identity, patient or business data.
Bottom views show genuine container floors, continuous loops and open rear straps rather than painted holes.

Default hand studies are separated prop displays, not complete actors. Skin fingers visibly align with the eight intended grip zones; rear views expose terminal/clipboard hand placement inside their actual straps.
Cloth and book use open palm-root support, with the supported hand partly hidden in front views.
Opened book now separates its rigid half-page blocks, with a visibly raised stationary central spine inherited from the old book; this remains a deliberate art-review limitation.
Removed case lid is an isolated exploded study at the original lid height, not a gravity-supported ground placement.

sharedMasterAccounting: Twelve reference candidates, eleven new masters; exact LIFE106 cells, explicit role remap, canonical dependency and prior index unchanged. Opened form rotates original cells and adds inner cloth web, no resampling or new master.
limitations: Technical candidates; human art acceptance zero.
Original actor source, dimensions matrix, skeleton, protected clearance and controllers unavailable.
Eight default finite grips, two rear-strap supports, two palm-root supports; variants off-hand. No whole-body or all-motion clearance claim.
Book opening, case lid removal, cloth folds, hose and handle states are finite author studies; no page, linkage, cloth or hose animation.
Raised stationary book spine, rigid cloth fold, simplified brush bristles and rigid fingers remain for art review.
No original diagnosis, communication, ownership, inventory, power or light-supply state. Optical cores zero emission.
Single-joint rigid components; no soft skin, IK, fluid, refraction, load or medical certification.
Software WebGL does not certify hardware frame rate.
